title: EscrowState v0
description: Result of escrowState() in FLOP Observatory. Settlement only; says nothing about output quality. Matches EscrowState in observatory/src/types.ts.

escrow_id.description: The escrow id asked about. Lower-case 0x plus 64 hex when valid. An id that does not parse is echoed as given and the state is unverified.

state.description: unverified: missing, conflicting or malformed evidence. funded: a finalized EscrowOpened and no finalized terminal event. claimed: a finalized EscrowReleased. refunded: a finalized EscrowRefunded.

evidence.description: Finalized events on the pinned genesis behind the state. Always empty when unverified.

block_number.description: null when the source did not give it.

notes.description: Plain-language reasons: ignored events, conflicts, missing evidence. For people, not for parsing.

finalized_height.description: Finalized height the events were read at. null when unknown.

observed_at.description: When the events were read, ISO 8601.

trust.description: trusted RPC: one node was trusted, no light client. fixture: saved test data, not a live read.

scope.const: settlement only; says nothing about output quality
